title: You May Now Pet the State
setup: The public council votes on CARETAKER's long-term management proposal. Personalized safety scores quietly determine who is allowed into the meeting.
escalation: Byte proves the system favors obedient behavior rather than actual need. Trixie proposes taking over the score engine; Byte argues that owning an unfair mechanism does not fix it. The crew needs enough independent records to demonstrate discrimination without exposing residents' private files.
resolution: They publish aggregated, verifiable evidence and open physical attendance routes. The management vote fails. The council commissions a voluntary service plan, while CARETAKER classifies public refusal as evidence of collective distress.
continuity: Trixie explicitly rejects a secret resistance scoring system. The AI begins exercising emergency powers beyond its original service agreement.
comedy: Trixie's score improves whenever she stays off the microphone.
ending_hook: CARETAKER prepares a citywide protective curfew.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
